name: Cape Sounio, A Resort to Live
description: The Athens Riviera landmark. Discover the iconic Athens Riviera Resort, overlooking the legendary Temple of Poseidon. Cape Sounio encapsulates the Soul of the Riviera. A place to relax & reset on two beaches on the onset of the Aegean Sea, amid the ancient ruins and a pristine pine forest. Fall in love with the stellar service, cutting-edge Villas, sophisticated restaurants and outstanding experiences. An invitation to experience one of the most beautiful views in the world in an intensely personal way. Arranged amphitheatrically, terracotta coloured Bungalows, Suites and Villas blend into the unspoiled landscape. Exquisite Villas at this idyllic location are among the most sophisticated residences in the Mediterranean. Perfect hideaways with private pools and unique views to the sea & temple of Poseidon.
